gold.question: What fixed amount in euro must an air carrier pay a passenger when it cancels a flight?
gold.unanswerable_reason: None of the five frozen directives states a fixed euro amount payable by an air carrier for cancellation of a flight. Directive 2011/83/EU excludes passenger transport services from its scope except Article 8(2) and Articles 19 and 22, and those provisions concern information, payment fees and additional payments rather than a cancellation tariff. A recital mentions a compensation regime for service aspects of mixed contracts but states no airline amount. The goods, digital-content, unfair-term and unfair-practice directives do not set one either.
gold.refusal_reference: The frozen five-document corpus does not contain sufficient information to answer this question.
